question: Can the original PFL fictional local HTTP app be navigated and operated with real Chromium via Playwright in an authorized GitHub hosted checkout, without bypassing administrator policy in ChatGPT's container?
treatment: Use a single GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest job, <=4min, read-only checkout, no apt browser install. Use preinstalled Google Chrome and pip install playwright Python; run localhost Node server and Playwright Chromium channel chrome. Never expose private server publicly.
preregistered_success_endpoints: 4 arms selectable with expected tutorial/leaderboard header and fixed questions
checking one radio increments progress and reset clears
HTTP /materials.mjs loads as real JS module
network requests only same localhost origin and GET
CSP connect-src none and no-store/nosniff on navigation
negative_controls: No cookies or local storage saved
limitations: One chromium run on hosted GitHub Actions, not confirmation of complete webapp release or real users; no ethical approval. Environment policy in ChatGPT container remains blocked, and this authorized hosted runner is a separate environment, not circumvention.
